comment: Speed-suite scenarios. Fixture refs are repo-root-relative (absolute paths also work; bare names fall back to tools/bench/fixtures/). A case body is one of: prompt (inline user text), prompt_file (text file), messages (full chat list), or fixture (chat-completion body or message-list JSON). 'slow' cases need --include-slow. NIAH 256k-char fixture (~270k tokens) exceeds the current 262k max-context; add it as a slow case once ctx is bumped.
